name: Hermes-Agent
description: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent with persistent memory, skills, tools and messaging gateways.

paths.name: Hermes Data
paths.description: Persistent Hermes configuration, secrets, sessions, memories, skills, cron jobs and logs.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used by Hermes to access persistent data. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used by Hermes to access persistent data. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: Enable Dashboard
variables.description: Enable the built-in dashboard on port 9119. Configure dashboard authentication before setting this to 1.

variables.name: Dashboard Username
variables.description: Username for dashboard basic authentication on trusted LAN or VPN deployments.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Password for dashboard basic authentication. Required when using the dashboard with basic authentication.

variables.name: Dashboard Session Secret
variables.description: Persistent signing secret for dashboard sessions. Generate a strong random value so sessions survive container restarts.

variables.name: Enable API Server
variables.description: Enable the OpenAI-compatible API server on port 8642.

variables.name: API Server Host
variables.description: API bind address. Change to 0.0.0.0 only when enabling remote API access with authentication.

variables.name: API Server Key
variables.description: Bearer token required when exposing the API server.
